name: Mortgage loan officer

pf.license.need: Always. Each loan officer: their own loan officer license for the state the home is in (a bank's loan officer: their federal registration, where the state's rules allow it). The company: its own lender or broker license for that state.
pf.license.ask: Each loan officer's registry ID (NMLS ID), at sign-up or in their invite reply. The company's registry ID, and the states it's licensed in.
pf.license.who holds it: Each loan officer, and the company.
pf.license.how it's checked: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks going live: No loan officer licensed for a state: no calls for homes in that state. A company not licensed in a state is never offered there.
pf.license.renewals: Checked on each renewal date from the state's form. A lapsed license pauses that loan officer's bookings, and Sam is told.
pf.license.unlicensed staff: An assistant with no loan officer license, like Pat, only schedules: books, moves and cancels times. They never talk about loans, rates or programs.
pf.license.insurance: A surety bond for the company where the state's rules require it; the amount comes from the state's form.
pf.license.background check: Part of the license itself. Rosie adds none.

pf.services.pattern: Consult: a free first call with a named loan officer who is licensed for the state the home is in. Flow A: by phone, by video, or a meeting at the branch. Flow B: at the customer's home, or on set days at a host's place, like a home-buying class or an open house.

at the business (the example company's o.name: Follow-up call

at the customer's place (the example com.rule: a set start time, never a window

at the customer's place (the example com.where: a host's place, like a real estate office's open house, with its OK

pf.services.the loan itself: Never booked, priced or applied for in Rosie. The application, the credit check, documents, the Loan Estimate, the appraisal and closing all happen in the lender's own tools, after the call. Any fees there are the lender's own, outside Rosie.
pf.services.capacity: One loan officer per booking. A co-buyer may join the same call.
pf.services.online: Phone and video calls count as at the business. The loan officer must be licensed for the state the home is in, wherever the customer is that day.
pf.services.booking window: Up to 60 days ahead, with at least 2 hours' notice (the business's settings).
pf.services.blocked times: Closings and other meetings block times, from the loan officer's calendar or a BLOCK text.

before times: Which state is the home in? The state only.
By phone, by video or at the branch? Or at your home?
A loan officer by name, or the soonest one? Rosie never ranks or suggests one.
after a time is picked: Is this your first home? Yes or no.
Have you found a home yet? Yes or no only.
Are you working with a real estate agent? Yes or no.
Anything that helps the call, like an interpreter or a step-free way in.
only on the secure page: Is it safe to text you? If not, how should the business reach you?
A home meeting: the street address, kept only as where to meet
A tick: Rosie books the loan officer's time only. It isn't a lender, takes no application and gives no advice
A tick: texts are about this booking only
pf.questions.never asked: Income, Social Security number, the home's price or address for the loan, the home's value, the loan amount, a credit score, bank, debt or ID numbers. Never anything about race, color, religion, national origin, sex, marital status, age (beyond 18 or older), disability, family, or where income comes from.
pf.questions.who may book: An adult books for themselves. A co-buyer may be added on the secure page. Another adult may book for someone, but the borrower gives their own yes on the secure page and takes the call.

words that stop a booking: someone is in danger right now
words that go on with safety steps: behind on mortgage payments, or a foreclosure notice
someone pushing the customer to borrow, sign or put a home in their name

what Rosie says.behind on payments: A free housing counselor approved by HUD can help: 800-569-4287. The booking goes on.
what Rosie says.pushed to borrow or sign: The loan officer talks with the borrower alone first. The booking goes on, and Sam is told.

pf.safety.money questions: Never answered by Rosie: rates, payments, what someone can afford, or whether they'll be approved. They wait for the loan officer.

required: None. The free call is the first step. Any application, credit check or documents come after it, in the lender's own tools.
prep for the reminder: Have a short list of questions. No papers are needed for this call, and please never text any.

pf.visit.check-in: Phone or video: the loan officer asks for the 4-digit code at the start, which also shows they're talking to the person who booked. At the branch: the code at the front desk. At a home: the code at the door.
pf.visit.at check-in: The loan officer says their name, company and registry ID, and that this first call is free.
pf.visit.work changes: Extra time on the same call is free, with the customer's yes. A second call is its own booking.
pf.visit.the home is in another state: The loan officer stops talking about the loan. Rosie offers a loan officer licensed there, if the business has one, or says plainly it can't help there.
pf.visit.after the call: The loan officer may send the lender's own application link, from the lender's own tools. Rosie books a follow-up call only if the customer or the loan officer asks.
pf.visit.Rosie never: Takes an application, runs or OKs a credit check, collects documents, sends disclosures, or touches the lender's own loan tools.

pf.money.before: Nothing taken, and no card saved.
pf.money.after: Nothing to pay through Rosie. Any application, credit report, appraisal or closing costs are the lender's own, in its own tools.
pf.money.fees: No cancel, late or no-show fee, ever. Before its Loan Estimate and the customer's go-ahead, a lender may charge only a credit-report fee, in its own tools.
pf.money.never: No deposit, hold, full price or bill through Rosie.
pf.money.rosfield: The business pays Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking by default, never more than $49 a month per person. With no payments through Rosie, it goes on the monthly bill. A switch turns it off where referral-fee rules forbid a per-booking fee for settlement-service work; Rosfield's lawyer must confirm it before launch.

never in a text: income, prices, loan amounts, credit scores, account or ID numbers
rates or what someone can afford
pf.messages.registry IDs: Each text that names a loan officer shows their registry ID and the company's, where the state's rules require it.
pf.messages.documents: A pay stub, ID or statement texted by mistake is deleted, never passed on, and the customer is asked not to send them.
pf.messages.rate questions: Go to the loan officer on a secure page. The loan officer answers on the call.
pf.messages.no nudges: Booking texts only: no rate offers, loan promotions or 'book again' lines.
pf.messages.loan notes: The loan officer's notes go in the lender's own tools. Rosie keeps only the time, the kind of call and the outcome.

pf.staff.licenses: Each loan officer: their own license for each state they take calls for (optional, shown as given, not checked by Rosie).
pf.staff.skills: Buying, refinancing, first-time buyer programs, home-buying classes, Spanish.
pf.staff.supervision: None for a licensed loan officer. An unlicensed assistant, like Pat, only schedules.
pf.staff.who OKs: Sam OKs branch and home meetings. Sam may let each loan officer OK their own.
pf.staff.fair lending: Loan officers are offered by soonest time, never ranked by rates, pay or anything about the customer. Nobody is steered to or from a loan officer.

pf.rules.books right away: Phone and video calls. Branch and home meetings ask Sam first (a switch).
pf.rules.the home's state: Only loan officers licensed for the state the home is in are offered.
pf.rules.named: The customer may name a loan officer. A named loan officer is never swapped on silence: Sam calls instead.
pf.rules.rosfield's $2: On by default; a switch for referral-fee rules (Rosfield's lawyer list).
pf.rules.referral pay: Rosfield takes nothing per lead or per loan, and never ranks loan officers.
pf.rules.registry IDs in texts: On, where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form).
pf.rules.records: Rosie keeps only times, the kind of call and the outcome.

pf.edges.money details in a request: Removed before anything is saved. The AI is told once.
pf.edges.a rate question: Passed to the loan officer privately. Rosie never quotes.
pf.edges.a question about a kind of income: Like disability income: passed privately, and nobody is ever discouraged from applying.
pf.edges.behind on payments: The housing counselor line, and the booking goes on.
pf.edges.no loan officer licensed for that state: Nothing booked. Rosie says so plainly.
pf.edges.the loan officer can't come: Sam offers another licensed loan officer, or calls. Nobody is moved on silence.
pf.edges.the customer applies: In the lender's own tools, never Rosie.
pf.edges.someone presses the borrower: The loan officer talks with the borrower alone first.

notes:
Pilot: lawyer (consult: a first call with a named professional, papers kept private). Its structure ops were kept where they fit (no deposit or full price, no photos path, named stand-ins, no plans, packs or rentals). Its renames and its no-$2 ops were dropped: mortgage work PAYS the $2, so the master's $2 words are right as they stand. Renames were rebuilt from the master.
Cast: Sam Lee owns Lee Mortgage LLC (flow B's company, 1500 Main St: mortgage lending plus homebuyer education; loan officers Victor Hale and Omar Haddad, he as in the master) and Lee Lending LLC (flow A's company, the branch at 210 Elm St; loan officers Tyler Nguyen and Angela Brooks, named or 'they' only). Pat is the office manager with no loan officer license: Pat only schedules. Alex M. has no pronoun.
Registry IDs are example numbers (NMLS 5550101 Sam, 5550142 Tyler, 5550188 Angela, 5550160 Victor; companies 5550177 Lee Lending, 5550110 Lee Mortgage).
Money: every call and meeting is free. One path per flow: A list|none|counter (nothing taken; 'after' relabeled 'Nothing to pay through Rosie'), B list|none|own.
